edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber II 2

source_text: Nolite me considerare quod fusca sim, quia decoloravit me sol. Sol tentationum et persecutionum aliquando animam adurit et colorem mutat, non tamen formam interiorem aufert. Filii matris meae pugnaverunt contra me: qui ex eadem gente vel synagoga videbantur, ecclesiam persecuti sunt. Posuerunt me custodem in vineis; vineam meam non custodivi: dum alienas curas suscipit, propriam aliquando negligit.
pass_a_gloss: Do-not me consider that dark I-may-be, because discolored me sun. Sun of-trials and of-persecutions sometimes soul scorches... Sons of-mother my fought against me...
pass_b_english: [[Do not look at me because I am dark, for the sun has discolored me >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:6]]. The sun of trials and persecutions sometimes scorches the soul and changes its color, yet does not take away inner beauty. [[My mother’s sons fought against me >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:6]]: those who seemed of the same people or synagogue persecuted the church. [[They made me keeper of the vineyards; my own vineyard I have not kept >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:6]]: while she takes up others’ cares, she sometimes neglects her own.
